assets.rightsBasis: Official SASTRA logo served from the university's own admissions portal (webstream.sastra.edu) as the banner of the Applicant Registration 2026 page. No open licence; used only to identify the institution. Checked 2026-10-23: HTTP 200, image/png, 93,585 bytes, 1349x344 px, RGBA with a transparent background. Rendered on white and visually confirmed legible: the blue SASTRA crest ('Progress through quality education', 'Shanmugha Arts, Science, Technology & Research Academy'), the wordmark 'SASTRA', the strap 'Engineering - Management - Law - Sciences - Humanities - Education', 'Deemed to be University (U/S 3 of the UGC Act, 1956)', a '40 years' anniversary badge, and 'Thanjavur | Kumbakonam | Chennai'. Wide lock-up; for square tiles crop to the crest at the left. The site header logo /templates/santosh/images/sastratransp.png (300x85) was not chosen because it is smaller.

Official institutional photograph used on the 'About SASTRA' page of the university's own domain (sastra.edu). No open licence; used only to depict the institution. Checked 2026-10-23: HTTP 200, image/jpeg, 120,163 bytes, 1600x720 px (landscape). Visually confirmed as a single real photograph, not a composite or AI image: a lawn in front of a long cream multi-storey building with a central curved, glass-fronted block in brick red, and the Indian national flag on a tall mast under an overcast sky; no text overlay or watermark; no identifiable people. Rejected: slideshow2026/02.jpeg and 05.jpeg (promotional composites with text and identifiable students), hostel/vb1-1.jpg (hostel block with caption text 'Vinaya hostel (block 1)' burnt into the image; possible student-life accommodation image only).
assets.altText: Multi-storey academic building with a curved glass-fronted central block and the Indian flag at Shanmugha Arts, Science, Technology & Research Academy (SASTRA)
